$comment: The permission rules modules can bring (modules.json `dependencies.permissions`). `config` is the entry's place in .claude/settings.json `permissions`: its `allow`, `ask` and `deny` rules are added there; rules no module needs any more are removed, and the project's own rules stay. `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out.

env-files.description: Claude never reads the secrets in `.env` files.
